response.original_title: Islam Rising: A Call to One World Ummah (Domination)
response.overview: Directed by Caryl Matrisciana, Islam Rising: A Call to One World Ummah (Domination) examines Islam as a comprehensive religious, legal, and political system, arguing that the concept of the ummah (global Muslim community) drives a movement toward worldwide influence and governance. Through interviews with former Muslims, converts to Christianity, authors, and commentators—including Nonie Darwish, Brigitte Gabriel, Walid Shoebat, and Kamal Saleem—the documentary explores themes of jihad, dawah, Western culture, and interfaith relations from a Christian perspective.
response.tagline: An inside look at Islam as a religious, legal, and political system.
response.title: Islam Rising: A Call to One World Ummah (Domination)
